# TS-005: Tailnet Lock state

- **Group:** Tailscale
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Tailnet Lock makes nodes verify new node keys with signing keys you hold, so a compromised coordination server cannot add nodes to your tailnet. It is optional and adds key management; this check only reports whether it is on.

## Verify by hand

```sh
tailscale lock status
```

## How to fix it

Consider Tailnet Lock for tailnets that reach servers (tailscale lock init)
